cte-recursive-select: WITH RECURSIVE "recent_hires" AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT "employees"."id", "employees"."name", "employees"."hired_at" FROM "employees" WHERE "employees"."hired_at" >= :q1), "tree_paths" AS (SELECT "tree_nodes"."id", "tree_nodes"."parent_id", "tree_nodes"."name" FROM "tree_nodes" WHERE "tree_nodes"."parent_id" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT "child"."id", "child"."parent_id", "child"."name" FROM "tree_nodes" AS "child" JOIN "tree_paths" ON "child"."parent_id" = "tree_paths"."id") SELECT "tree_paths"."id", "tree_paths"."name", COALESCE("recent_hires"."name", 'n/a') AS recent_name FROM "tree_paths" LEFT JOIN "recent_hires" ON "tree_paths"."id" = "recent_hires"."id" ORDER BY "tree_paths"."id" ASC
